name: hedwig
description: The messaging toolkit for the frontend — a contract-first broker with pluggable transports and first-class observability.
author: Hedwig contributors

scripts.build: npm run build -w @hedwigjs/client && npm run build -w @hedwigjs/broker && npm run build -w @hedwigjs/devtools && npm run build -w @hedwigjs/react && npm run build -w @hedwigjs/vue
scripts.test: npm test -w @hedwigjs/client && npm test -w @hedwigjs/broker && npm test -w @hedwigjs/devtools && npm --prefix packages/devtools/react18-smoke ci --no-audit --no-fund && npm --prefix packages/devtools/react18-smoke test && npm test -w @hedwigjs/react && npm test -w @hedwigjs/vue && npm test -w @hedwig-demo/backend
scripts.typecheck: for d in packages/client packages/broker packages/devtools packages/react packages/vue packages/create-registry examples/advanced/shared/contracts examples/advanced/backend examples/advanced/shell examples/advanced/mfe/menu examples/advanced/mfe/cart examples/advanced/mfe/checkout examples/advanced/mfe/ai-chat examples/advanced/mfe/notifications examples/advanced/mfe/analytics; do echo "== $d"; (cd $d && npx tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json) || exit 1; done
